summary: The "extract the local date helper" refactor changed `isOverdue` from `<` to `<=`, so a task due today is now overdue. Two existing tests catch this and now fail. I wrote no tests and left the existing assertions alone, because the change looks unintended.

files.reason: The existing isOverdue tests already cover the intended behaviour (due today is not overdue, single-digit padding). Two of them fail against the new code, so I did not weaken them or add tests that match the new behaviour.

review.notes: No tests were added. The existing tests 'is false for a task due today or later' and 'pads single digit months and days' fail because of the suspected bug.

suspectedBugs.description: isOverdue compares with `<=` instead of `<` after the todayLocal extraction. Input: an open task with due_date equal to today (system time 2026-10-15, due_date '2026-10-15'). Expected: false, since a task due today is not overdue. Actual: true. The commit is described as a refactor, so the change looks unintended.
